### Peer Review

> Source: https://www.journals.uchicago.edu/doi/full/10.1086/690143

### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 2 |
| **Summary** | Journal-specific policy announced 2025-12-03 (reported via Daily Nous, citing the journal's own statement). Authors: AI cannot be listed as author/co-author; using AI to generate ideas without citing original sources = plagiarism; AI use permitted for tasks like sentence editing/rewriting or as a research aid ONLY WITH disclosure of which tools were used and how. Editors/reviewers: forbidden from uploading confidential submissions to AI services without proper access controls, from using AI-generated summaries to assess papers, or from drafting any part of a review report with AI. Non-compliance can lead to sanctions including bans from reviewing/submitting. Rated 2/5 leniency: core authorial content generation and undisclosed AI use are banned, though assistive/editing use is allowed with disclosure. |
| **Source URL** | https://dailynous.com/2025/12/03/ethics-announces-ai-policy/ |

### Preprint Policy

> AI-research note (not broken down per-stage): Discouraged/conditional: the journal's own author instructions ask authors NOT to post or publish online (e.g., preprint servers, working-paper series) manuscripts submitted or intended for submission, because doing so may compromise the anonymous (triple-blind) review process or could be treated as prior publication (especially if the posted version has a DOI, underwent review, or carries a repository's imprimatur). Non-commercial institutional/disciplinary self-archiving of the author's own work is permitted post-publication at no cost.
> Source: https://www.journals.uchicago.edu/journals/et/instruct

**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** General moral, political, and legal philosophy scholarship: new normative theory, application of theory to contemporary moral issues, and historically-informed work with contemporary theoretical implications. Also publishes critical discussions, symposia, review essays, and book reviews. Could not retrieve a live list of 2024-2026 article titles (publisher site returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch and search snippets did not surface individual titles), so 'accepts_now' is based on the journal's stated aims and scope, not a title-level sample of recent issues.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** analytic normative/moral theory, political philosophy, legal philosophy, social and political theory, applied ethics (theory applied to contemporary moral issues), history of ethics with contemporary theoretical relevance, critical discussion/response pieces and symposia

- **positioning.accepts_now (title-level sample)**: journals.uchicago.edu blocks automated WebFetch (403) and no third-party site listed individual recent (2024-2026) article titles/topics in search results, so positioning is based on stated aims & scope only, not an actual sample of what got published/accepted recently
- **positioning special-issue/CFP**: No current (2026) special issue or call-for-papers found for Ethics in search results; journal appears to run standard issues without themed CFPs
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No SciRev entry found for this journal (searches returned other 'Ethics'-named journals like Journal of Business Ethics, Journal of Academic Ethics, but no page specifically for Ethics ISSN 0014-1704); zero results on 小木虫/muchong, 知乎, and no r/AskAcademia or r/askphilosophy threads found discussing this specific journal's reviewer culture -- left null rather than inventing a narrative
- **experiential.review_time_months (crowd-sourced figure)**: No SciRev listing found for this exact journal; the review-time figures reported here come from the journal's own author-instructions page (publisher source) plus one secondhand forum reference (12-18 months) in Daily Nous comments, not a verified first-hand crowd-sourced dataset

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per methodology):**
- SciRev: no listing found for 'Ethics' (ISSN 0014-1704) specifically -- only adjacent journals like Journal of Business Ethics, Journal of Academic Ethics, Journal of Ethics and Social Philosophy appeared
- 小木虫 muchong.com: 0 results -- this niche English-language analytic-philosophy journal has essentially no Chinese-language academic-forum footprint
- 知乎 zhihu: 0 results specific to this journal -- searches surfaced only generic '伦理声明/ethics statement' articles about research-ethics disclosures (a different meaning of '伦理'), not discussion of submitting to this journal
- Reddit r/AskAcademia and r/askphilosophy: 0 results -- no threads found discussing submission/review experience at this specific journal
